ordered_diagnoses: Hepatic vein thrombosis due to membranous obstruction

s1.syndrome_frame: subacute febrile illness with back pain and multiple organ involvement
salient_findings: fever and back pain lasting 3 weeks
key_facts: 76-year-old Japanese man
presented with fever and back pain
endoscopic treatment for common bile duct stones 3 weeks prior
medical history of diabetes mellitus and hypertension
taking cilnidipine and metformin hydrochloride
smoking 20 cigarettes per day for 47 years
consuming 70g of ethanol daily
elevated CRP (22.1 mg/dL) and WBC (11,910/μL)
low platelet count (10.3 × 104/μL)
elevated ALP (275 U/L) and low albumin (1.7 g/dL)
abnormal liver imaging with two hypodense lesions in the right liver lobe
multiple cavitated nodules in lungs on CT and MRI
thrombosis of hepatic vein on CT and MRI
low-density area of left-sided iliopsoas muscle swelling on CT and MRI
enlarged high-signal areas in L4/5 intervertebral disc on MRI
gram-negative bacilli on Gram staining
positive cultures (blood, urine, and abscess fluid) for identified organism
